home.hero_sub: Where Pacific living meets refined taste. Cars, culture, and the gentleman's pursuit of excellence.
home.intro_p1: The West Coast Gentleman is a celebration of everything the Pacific coast stands for — freedom, beauty, and the relentless pursuit of the finer things. From show-stopping cars to sun-soaked coastal culture, this is where passion meets refinement.
home.intro_p2: Whether you're a connoisseur of horsepower or simply drawn to an elevated way of living, you've found your community.
home.quote: A gentleman doesn't just drive a car — he commands the road, the room, and the moment.

about.hero_sub: Born on the West Coast. Raised on horsepower and salt air.
about.origin_p1: The West Coast Gentleman started as a personal expression — a way to document the intersection of refined living and raw automotive passion that defines life along the Pacific. What began as a simple Instagram account grew into a community of like-minded individuals who share a deep appreciation for craftsmanship, culture, and the open road.
about.origin_p2: Every post, every collaboration, every sun-drenched photo shoot is driven by a single belief: a gentleman's character is reflected in the details — how he dresses, what he drives, and how he carries himself through the world.

values.title: Authenticity
values.text: Every car featured, every collaboration pursued is genuine. No filters on who we are or what we love.

values.title: Craftsmanship
values.text: From the stitching on a leather seat to the tailoring of a suit — details are everything.

values.title: Community
values.text: This brand belongs to everyone who has ever felt the pull of a perfect machine or a flawless sunset.

values.title: Excellence
values.text: We don't settle for ordinary. The West Coast sets a standard — and we live it every single day.

timeline.title: The Account Launches
timeline.text: A passion project becomes public. The first posts go live — raw, authentic, and immediately resonant with car lovers across the West Coast.

timeline.title: First Brand Collaboration
timeline.text: Partnering with premier automotive brands and lifestyle labels, The West Coast Gentleman earns its place in the culture.

timeline.title: The Community Grows
timeline.text: 10,000 followers and counting. Events, meetups, and an ever-expanding family of gentlemen who share the vision.

timeline.title: A Full Platform
timeline.text: From social media to a full website — The West Coast Gentleman expands to serve its community with content, services, and culture.

featured.description: The Roma is poetry in motion — a front-engined grand tourer that captures the dolce vita spirit in every curve. Shot against the California coastline at golden hour.

services.intro_p1: The West Coast Gentleman is more than a personal brand — it's a platform. With an engaged audience of automotive enthusiasts, lifestyle aficionados, and style-conscious men across the Pacific, a collaboration here carries genuine weight.
services.intro_p2: Every project is approached with the same standard that defines the brand: precision, passion, and Pacific cool.

cards.title: Brand Partnerships
cards.description: Authentic, long-form brand integrations that resonate with a discerning automotive and lifestyle audience. No hard sells — only storytelling that fits the brand ethos.

cards.title: Automotive Photography
cards.description: High-end automotive photography that captures the soul of a machine. Every shoot is planned around the perfect light, location, and moment.

cards.title: Content Creation
cards.description: From concept to final cut — cinematic short-form content for brands, events, and personal vehicles that performs across every platform.

cards.title: Brand Consulting
cards.description: Not sure how to position your brand in the automotive lifestyle space? Tap into years of community building and content strategy for expert guidance.

cards.title: Event Coverage
cards.description: Car shows, garage reveals, launch events — we capture it all with the eye of someone who genuinely loves what they're documenting.

cards.title: Custom Package
cards.description: Have something specific in mind? The West Coast Gentleman is open to one-of-a-kind collaborations that push the standard of what's possible.
